<TR>
<TD WIDTH="3%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>&#149;</B></FONT></TD>
<TD WIDTH="1%" VALIGN="top"><FONT SIZE="1">&nbsp;</FONT></TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P ALIGN="left"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>March incentives decline sharply from February </B></FONT></P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT
STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">DETROIT &#150; March capped a successful quarter for General Motors in the United States. Retail sales surged 38 percent for its four brands, driven by demand for Chevrolet&#146;s all-new Cruze compact
sedan. In spite of a decline in incentives, dealers reported 206,621 total sales during March, an increase of 11 percent. This total included a 17 percent increase in retail sales, compared to March 2010. </FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">March&#146;s retail sales increase was spurred by a 34-percent rise in passenger car retail sales, led by a 287 percent gain in retail sales of the Cruze
over the car it replaced. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">March deliveries to fleets declined 1 percent and represented 27 percent of the company&#146;s total sales &#150;
the ninth straight month that fleet sales comprised less than 30 percent of total sales. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">For the first three months, total sales increased 26
percent to 592,545 units compared to a year earlier. As a result, each of GM&#146;s brands &#150; Chevrolet, Buick, GMC and Cadillac &#150; gained retail and total market share during the quarter. </FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">&#147;Our plan was to get out of the gates quickly in the first quarter and we succeeded,&#148; said Don Johnson, vice president, U.S. Sales Operations.
&#147;Consumers responded favorably to the value of our broad lineup of fuel-efficient cars, trucks and crossovers.&#148; </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">In the first
quarter, fleet sales represented 24 percent of the company&#146;s total sales volume, compared to 30 percent in the first quarter of 2010. </FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:18px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B><I>GM&#146;s Newest Vehicles Continue to Drive Retail Gains &#150; up 54 Percent in March </I></B></FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Combined retail sales for vehicles launched since June 2009 &#150; Chevrolet Equinox, Silverado HD, Cruze and Volt; Buick LaCrosse and Regal; GMC Sierra
HD and Terrain; and Cadillac SRX, CTS Wagon and CTS Coupe &#150; increased 54 percent during March and were up 74 percent for the first three months of the year. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT
STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">&#147;March sales demonstrated our newest models continue to win over customers,&#148; Johnson said. &#147;Vehicles like the Chevrolet Cruze and Equinox put us in great position to benefit from
consumer&#146;s increasing desire for fuel-efficient vehicles.&#148; </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:18px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B><I>Passenger Cars </I></B></FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Total sales of GM passenger cars improved 15 percent during March, led by the sale of 18,018 Cruzes. Retail sales of GM passenger cars rose 34 percent for
the month. The Cruze, Chevrolet Camaro Convertible and Buick Regal all have achieved record retail sales since being launched. For the quarter, retail sales of GM&#146;s passenger cars were up 49 percent, also led by the Cruze, up 203 percent.
</FONT></P>

<p Style='page-break-before:always'>
<HR  SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B><I>Crossovers </I></B></FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT
STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">The Chevrolet, GMC and Cadillac brands each set March total and retail sales records for crossover sales during the month, driven by a 20 percent increase in combined retail sales by the Chevrolet Equinox
and GMC Terrain. The two also set March records for retail sales. For the quarter, retail sales of GM&#146;s complete lineup of industry-leading crossovers were up 30 percent. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:18px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT
STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B><I>Pickups </I></B></FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Total combined sales of Chevrolet Silverado and Avalanche, and GMC Sierra
increased 11 percent in March, with retail sales also rising 11 percent versus a year ago. For the quarter, retail sales for GM&#146;s full-size pickups rose 38 percent, while total sales improved to 130,866 units &#150; a 31-percent increase.
</FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:18px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B><I>Incentives </I></B></FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">During
March, purchase incentives declined on a per unit basis. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">&#147;We&#146;ve said all along that our plan for the year was to be at or near
industry average on incentives as a percent of average transaction prices, as we were last year,&#148; Johnson said. &#147;Our actions in March were consistent with that plan and we will continue to be prudent in our go-to-market approach.&#148;
</FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Month-end dealer inventory in the United States stood at about 574,000 units, which is about 57,000 higher compared to February and about
149,000 higher than March 2010. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:18px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>Brand Key Facts: </B></FONT></P> <P STYLE="font-size:6px;margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">&nbsp;</P>

<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P ALIGN="left"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B><I>Chevrolet:</I></B> <I>Chevrolet dealers delivered 148,197 total vehicles in March, an 11-percent increase versus last year. Retail sales for
Chevrolet were up 18 percent. Cruze retail sales were 287 percent higher than the compact car it replaced. Silverado retail sales rose 10 percent, while Equinox retail sales increased 18 percent (<U>read more</U>).</I> </FONT></P></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px" ALIGN="center"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>Chevrolet Sales Climb 23 Percent in First Quarter </B></FONT></P> <P STYLE="font-size:12px;margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR>
<TD WIDTH="5%"><FONT SIZE="1">&nbsp;</FONT></TD>
<TD WIDTH="2%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>&#149;</B></FONT></TD>
<TD WIDTH="1%" VALIGN="top"><FONT SIZE="1">&nbsp;</FONT></TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P ALIGN="left"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B></B><B>Retail sales for Chevrolet cars increased 42 percent in Q1 </B></FONT></P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="font-size:6px;margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR>
<TD WIDTH="5%"><FONT SIZE="1">&nbsp;</FONT></TD>
<TD WIDTH="2%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>&#149;</B></FONT></TD>
<TD WIDTH="1%" VALIGN="top"><FONT SIZE="1">&nbsp;</FONT></TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P ALIGN="left"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B></B><B>Camaro still America&#146;s best-selling sports car, with 19,972 Q1 sales </B></FONT></P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="font-size:6px;margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR>
<TD WIDTH="5%"><FONT SIZE="1">&nbsp;</FONT></TD>
<TD WIDTH="2%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>&#149;</B></FONT></TD>
<TD WIDTH="1%" VALIGN="top"><FONT SIZE="1">&nbsp;</FONT></TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P ALIGN="left"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B></B><B>Total sales for trucks and crossovers continue to grow: Equinox up 42 percent, Traverse up 30 percent, and Silverado up 28 percent in Q1
</B></FONT></P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">DETROIT &#150; Chevrolet posted a total of 148,197 sales in March, an 11 percent increase over the same month a year
ago. That number includes an 18 percent gain in retail sales, as Chevrolet&#146;s cars, trucks and crossovers continue to attract new customers. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT
STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Calendar year to date, Chevrolet has sold 416,505 vehicles, a 23 percent increase in total sales, while retail sales have climbed 37 percent for the year. </FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">&#147;Our first-quarter results show the strength of Chevrolet&#146;s portfolio,&#148; said Alan Batey, U.S. vice president, Chevrolet Sales and Service.
&#147;We offer compelling vehicles for every customer&#146;s needs &#150; from the fuel efficiency of the Chevrolet Cruze Eco to the capability of the Silverado HD, to the iconic performance of the Camaro.&#148; </FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>For the first quarter of 2011, total sales of Chevrolet cars are up 16 percent, while sales to individual customers are up 42 percent from a year ago.
</B></FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">The Chevrolet Cruze and Malibu continue to record strong sales, accounting for a total of 98,950 sales &#150; roughly one of every four
Chevrolets sold in the first quarter. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">The arrival of the new Camaro Convertible in late February has contributed to Camaro&#146;s lead as the
best-selling sports car in America. To date, a total of 19,972 Camaros have been sold. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">A total of 1,210 Chevrolet Volts have been delivered
in 2011, including 608 deliveries in March. In addition, approximately half of the 595 participating Volt launch dealers have taken delivery of their demonstration vehicles. These Volts will remain with the dealers for at least six months before
being sold, ensuring customers will have the chance to test drive the 2011 Motor Trend Car of the Year. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>For the first quarter, total sales
of Chevrolet&#146;s fuel-efficient crossovers climbed 36 percent, while retail sales were up 33 percent from a year ago. </B></FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">That includes a
30-percent increase for the eight-passenger Chevrolet Traverse and a 42- percent gain for the five-passenger Equinox. Combined, these two vehicles accounted for a total of 69,598 sales this year. </FONT></P>

<p Style='page-break-before:always'>
<HR  SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>Total sales for Chevrolet trucks and full-size utilities have climbed 25 percent so far in 2011, with
retail sales up 35 percent. </B></FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Sales of the Silverado line continued to grow, with total sales up 9 percent in March &#150; its fourteenth
consecutive month of year-over-year sales gains. For 2011, Silverado total sales increased 28 percent, while retail sales are up 37 percent. </FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:18px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B><I>About Chevrolet </I></B></FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Founded in
Detroit in 1911, Chevrolet celebrates its centennial as a global automotive brand with annual sales of about 4.25&nbsp;million vehicles in more than 130 countries. Chevrolet provides consumers with fuel-efficient, safe and reliable vehicles that
deliver high quality, expressive design, spirited performance and value. The Chevrolet portfolio includes iconic performance cars such as Corvette and Camaro; dependable, long-lasting pickups and SUVs such as Silverado and Suburban; and
award-winning passenger cars and crossovers such as Spark, Cruze, Malibu, Equinox and Traverse. Chevrolet also offers &#147;gas-friendly to gas-free&#148; solutions including Cruze Eco and Volt. Cruze Eco offers 42 mpg highway while Volt offers 35
miles of electric, gasoline-free driving and an additional 344 miles of extended range. Most new Chevrolet models offer OnStar safety, security and convenience technologies including OnStar Hands-Free Calling, Automatic Crash Response and Stolen
Vehicle Slowdown. More information regarding Chevrolet models can be found at <U>www.chevrolet.com</U>. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px" ALIGN="center"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">### </FONT></P>

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">

 <P STYLE="margin-top:24px;margin-bottom:0px" ALIGN="center"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>Buick Retail Sales Rise 49 Percent in First Quarter </B></FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px;padding-bottom:0px;" ALIGN="center"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><I>Regal, Enclave propel 18<FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="1"><SUP
STYLE="vertical-align:baseline; position:relative; bottom:.8ex">th</SUP></FONT><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"> straight month of retail sales gains in March </FONT></I></FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px;padding-bottom:0px;"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>DETROIT </B>&#150; Buick, the fastest growing major automotive brand in the United States in 2010, finished the first quarter of
calendar year 2011 with retail sales up 49 percent and total sales up 39 percent. March also marked Buick&#146;s
18</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="1"><SUP STYLE="vertical-align:baseline; position:relative; bottom:.8ex">th</SUP></FONT><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"> straight month of growth with retail sales up 24
percent and total sales up 21 percent. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">&#147;Regal, LaCrosse and Enclave continue to attract new-to-Buick buyers seeking fuel efficiency,
luxury and style in the midsize sedan, full-size car and crossover segments,&#148; said Brian Sweeney, U.S. vice president of Buick&nbsp;&amp; GMC Sales and Service. &#147;We fully expect the arrival of the fuel-efficient LaCrosse with eAssist and
all-new Verano luxury compact to attract even more new customers to Buick.&#148; </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Approximately 38 percent of Buick buyers come from non-GM
brands and 17 percent come from imports. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Regal, which launched last April, continued to help Buick grow in March with demand for the sporty
sedan accelerating thanks to increased availability of the all-new Regal CXL Turbo, which accounted for 30 percent of Regal&#146;s retail sales in March. The turbo&#146;s 2.0-liter direct-injection four-cylinder engine delivers better horsepower and
torque than the Acura TSX, and with its manual six-speed transmission, it also delivers better fuel economy, with an EPA-rated 32 mpg highway. </FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Retail sales for LaCrosse also were up in the first quarter by 4 percent. The 2012 LaCrosse will feature eAssist, which uses an electric motor and
lithium-ion battery to capture energy created during braking. Electric power used for starts and stops and light power boost while cruising. </FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Enclave, which had the strongest sales in its four-year history last year, continued to grow in the first quarter of 2011 with retail sales up 24 percent
and total sales up 17 percent. Enclave&#146;s monthly total sales also were up 8 percent year over year. So far in 2011, Enclave has the highest conquest rate of any Buick at 46 percent. The crossover delivers better fuel economy than any
eight-passenger crossover, with 24 mpg highway (2WD). </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">&#147;Fuel efficient vehicles and positive word of mouth continue to draw new customers
to Buick showrooms,&#148; Sweeney said. &#147;Consumer interest in the brand also is evident by a 31-percent year-over-year increase in traffic at <U>Buick.com</U>, which is an important sales generator.&#148; </FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px;padding-bottom:0px;"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Some of Buick&#146;s hottest markets in the first quarter included Miami, New York and Houston; the latter is hosting the 2011 NCAA
Final Four<FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="1"><SUP STYLE="vertical-align:baseline; position:relative; bottom:.8ex">&reg;</SUP></FONT> basketball tournament, of which Buick is a sponsor. </FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px;padding-bottom:0px;"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Buick&#146;s new partnership with the NCAA started during March Madness<FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="1"><SUP
STYLE="vertical-align:baseline; position:relative; bottom:.8ex">&reg;</SUP></FONT> and continues to generate buzz online at <U>www.ncaa.com/buick</U>, the home of the Buick Human Highlight Reel. This collection of videos celebrates the achievements
of former student-athletes who are making a difference in their communities. Buick also is the exclusive title sponsor of a 30-minute television show featuring select Human Highlight Reel stories airing prior to the 2011 NCAA Men&#146;s Final Four<FONT
STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="1"><SUP STYLE="vertical-align:baseline; position:relative; bottom:.8ex">&reg;</SUP></FONT> semifinal games on April&nbsp;2. </FONT></P>

<p Style='page-break-before:always'>
<HR  SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>About Buick </B></FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT
STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B></B>Buick is a modern luxury brand offering vehicles with sculpted designs, luxurious interiors with thoughtful personal technologies, along with responsive-yet-efficient performance. Buick is
attracting new customers with its portfolio of award-winning models, including the Enclave crossover, LaCrosse sedan, Regal sport sedan and highly anticipated&nbsp;all-new 2012 Buick Verano compact luxury sedan. Buick is the fastest growing major
brand in the U.S. and&nbsp;remains a best-selling brand in China, with continuing record growth. Learn more about Buick cars and crossovers at <U>www.buick.com</U>, on Twitter <U>@buick</U> or at <U>www.facebook.com/buick</U>. </FONT></P>

 <P STYLE="margin-top:24px;margin-bottom:0px" ALIGN="center"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>GMC Finishes First Quarter Up 34 Percent in Retail Sales </B></FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px;padding-bottom:0px;" ALIGN="center"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><I>Terrain, Sierra and Yukon drive 18<FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="1"><SUP
STYLE="vertical-align:baseline; position:relative; bottom:.8ex">th</SUP></FONT><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"> straight month of gains in March </FONT></I></FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px;padding-bottom:0px;"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>DETROIT </B>&#150; GMC closed the first quarter of calendar year 2011 with retail sales up 34 percent and total sales up 31
percent. March also marked GMC&#146;s 18</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="1"><SUP STYLE="vertical-align:baseline; position:relative; bottom:.8ex">th</SUP></FONT><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"> straight month
of growth with retail and total sales up 11 percent, year over year. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">&#147;The first quarter showed continued strong consumer demand for
GMC&#146;s capable, fuel efficient, well-equipped trucks, sport utilities and crossovers,&#148; said Brian Sweeney, U.S. vice president of Buick&nbsp;&amp; GMC Sales and Service. &#147;Terrain, in particular, attracted buyers with its
segment-leading fuel economy.&#148; </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Terrain, which has the highest conquest rate of any GMC model at 46 percent, delivered a first quarter
increase of 43 percent in retail sales and 53 percent in total sales. The crossover&#146;s monthly retail sales rose 26 percent and its total sales climbed 29 percent year over year. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT
STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">The Sierra lineup&#146;s first-quarter retail and total sales were up 44 percent; Sierra&#146;s year-over-year monthly retail sales were up 15 percent and total sales were up 17 percent in March. Sierra
2500HD recently earned <I>Truck Trend </I>magazine&#146;s &#147;Best in Class&#148; accolade in the work truck category. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><I>Truck Trend</I>
also named Yukon the &#147;Best in Class&#148; full-size SUV. In the first quarter, Yukon/XL&#146;s combined retail sales were up 38 percent contributing to a total sales increase of 40 percent; Yukon/XL&#146;s monthly retail sales were up 25
percent and total sales were up 14 percent, year over year. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Acadia&#146;s first quarter retail sales were up 11 percent and total sales were
up 5 percent. Acadia offers the best highway fuel economy of any eight-passenger crossover SUV. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">&#147;GMC&#146;s commitment to delivering
professional grade capability and fuel efficiency in a boldly styled package continues to win new buyers month after month,&#148; Sweeney said. </FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:18px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>About GMC </B></FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">GMC has built trucks since
1902, and is one of the industry&#146;s healthiest brands. Today GMC is evolving to offer more fuel-efficient trucks and crossovers, including the Terrain small SUV and Acadia crossover. The new GMC Sierra Heavy Duty pickups are the most capable and
powerful trucks in the market. Innovation and engineering excellence are woven into all GMCs, including the Yukon and Yukon XL and full line of Sierra pickups. Today, GMC is the only manufacturer offering three full-size hybrid trucks. Details on
all GMC models are available at <U>www.gmc.com</U>, on Twitter at @thisisgmc or at <U>www.facebook.com/gmc</U>. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px" ALIGN="center"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">###

<TD VALIGN="bottom"><FONT SIZE="1">&nbsp;</FONT></TD>
<TD VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">For Release: 10:45 a.m. EDT, April&nbsp;1, 2011</FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT
STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>CTS Leads Cadillac March Sales Growth</B></FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:1px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><I>First-quarter sales up 38 percent total, 49
percent retail with increases by CTS, SRX and Escalade</I></FONT></P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px;padding-bottom:0px;"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>DETROIT</B> &#150; Cadillac marked its
14</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="1"><SUP STYLE="vertical-align:baseline; position:relative; bottom:.8ex">th</SUP></FONT><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"> straight month of year-over-year total U.S. sales
gains driven by another strong month from the CTS. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Cadillac posted total U.S. sales in March of 12,164, up 5 percent from the same month last
year. Sales of the CTS line, which includes the CTS Sedan, Wagon and Coupe, rose 36 percent for the month to 3,904. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px;padding-bottom:0px;"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">March
marked the 11</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="1"><SUP STYLE="vertical-align:baseline; position:relative; bottom:.8ex">th</SUP></FONT><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"> consecutive month for total and retail
year-over-year sales gains for the CTS family. Sales of the SRX were up 3 percent to 4,221 in March as Cadillac&#146;s luxury crossover posted its 20</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="1"><SUP
STYLE="vertical-align:baseline; position:relative; bottom:.8ex">th</SUP></FONT><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"> straight month of total and retail year-over-year sales increases. </FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">The results add to an impressive start for Cadillac in 2011. Cadillac total U.S. sales in the first quarter of 2011 were up 38 percent, compared to the
first quarter of last year. For the first quarter, CTS sales rose 76 percent, SRX sales were up 29 percent and Escalade sales rose 9 percent. </FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">The CTS Coupe, introduced last year as a 2011 model, continued its successful launch. The Rocky Mountain Automotive Press Association this week named the
2011 CTS Coupe its New Vehicle of the Year. German automobile magazine Autobild Allrad recently selected the all-wheel-drive version of the CTS Coupe as Car of the Year in the sports car/coupe/convertible segment for import automobiles. </FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">&#147;The CTS Coupe has added new energy to Cadillac and its dealerships,&#148; said Kurt McNeil, vice president of Cadillac sales and service. &#147;It
continues to attract new and returning luxury buyers to the brand and expand a CTS line already known for bold styling and world-class performance.&#148; </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:18px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT
STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>About Cadillac </B></FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Cadillac has been a leading luxury auto brand since 1902. In recent years,
Cadillac has engineered a historic renaissance led by artful engineering and advanced technology. More information on Cadillac can be found at <U>media.cadillac.com</U>. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:18px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT
